title: I made an RPG you're supposed to ignore
author: lowpolysaint
selftext:
Pocket Adventurer sits in a little always-on-top strip above your Windows taskbar. Your hero clears dungeons down there while you work. Check in whenever. They'll be fine.

Probably.

My favorite part is that heroes retire. That's the prestige system: your next hero inherits the camp you've built, and in the full game, retired heroes get statues that make everyone after them stronger. Even when a hero's adventure ends, they're still helping the next one.  
Single-player, runs locally, Windows. Launches November 3 for $4.99, 20% off the first week, and it'll be in Steam Next Fest on October 19.

Free demo, first four dungeons, Playable Link: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5136070/Pocket\_Adventurer/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5136070/Pocket_Adventurer/)

Trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0uzNGiiQCI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0uzNGiiQCI)

The art is hand-drawn. I used AI tools to help turn my drawings into animation frames, then fixed and retimed every frame by hand. AI coding assistants helped with code.
